defs.en: A grasp or grip.
defs.ex: Keep a firm hold on the handlebars.

defs.en: An act or instance of holding.
defs.ex: Can I have a hold of the baby?

defs.en: A place where animals are held for safety
An order that something is to be reserved or delayed, limiting or preventing how it can be dealt with.
defs.ex: Senator X placed a hold on the bill, then went to the library and placed a hold on a book.

defs.en: Something reserved or kept.
defs.ex: We have a hold here for you.

defs.en: A national school-leaving examination and university entrance qualification.
To make higher; to raise or increase in amount or quantity.
To ascend.
A unit of time of one twenty-fourth of a day (sixty minutes).
defs.ex: Near-synonym: microcentury (humorous approximation)

defs.en: A season, moment, or time.
defs.ex: Don't come home ever again at this unearthly hour.

defs.en: The time.
defs.ex: The hour grows late and I must go home.

defs.en: Used after a two-digit hour and a two-digit minute to indicate time.
The amount of labor demanded by an employer in terms of time.
defs.ex: I asked my manager for more hours.

defs.en: Having or giving off a high temperature.
defs.ex: He forgot that the frying pan was hot and burned his hand.

defs.en: Feeling the sensation of heat, especially to the point of discomfort.
defs.ex: I was so hot from being in the sun too long.

defs.en: Feverish; feeling a high fever.
Active, in use or ready for use (like a bullet or a firing range), turned on (like a microphone or camera).
Electrically charged.
defs.ex: a hot wire

defs.en: Hotly; at a high temperature.
Rapidly, quickly.
While shooting, while firing one's weapon(s).
defs.ex: to come in hot; to go in hot

defs.en: To heat; to make or become hot.
To become lively or exciting.
A hot meal, usually in the phrase "three hots" (i.e. three hot meals per day) or derivations such as three hots and a cot.
An exclamation to get attention.
defs.ex: Hey, look at this!

defs.en: A protest or reprimand.
defs.ex: Hey! Stop that!

defs.en: An expression of surprise.
defs.ex: Hey! This is new!

defs.en: An informal greeting, similar to hi.
defs.ex: Hey! How's it going?

defs.en: A request for repetition or explanation; an expression of confusion.
defs.ex: Hey? How's that?

defs.en: To greet with a "hey"
A choreographic figure in which three or more dancers weave between one another, passing by left and right shoulder alternately.
An object of hatred.
defs.ex: One of my pet hates is traffic wardens.

defs.en: Hatred.
defs.ex: He gave me a look filled with pure hate.

defs.en: Negative feedback, abusive behaviour.
defs.ex: There was a lot of hate in the comments on my vlog about Lady Gaga from her fans.

defs.en: Bigotry.
defs.ex: The corporation said it would not tolerate hate.

defs.en: To dislike intensely or greatly.
defs.ex: As a kid, I used to hate to cycle to school every morning.

defs.en: To experience a feeling of hatred.
Used in a phrasal verb: hate on.
defs.ex: I put ranch dressing on pizza. Please don't hate on me.

ja: 憎む、憎悪する、嫌悪する。

defs.en: have not (negative form of have)
defs.ex: You've a bad back again, haven't you? - No, actually I haven't.

defs.en: A place or situation of great suffering in life.
defs.ex: My new boss is making my job a hell.

defs.en: A place for gambling.
An extremely hot place.
defs.ex: You don’t have a snowball's chance in hell.

defs.en: Used as an intensifier in phrases grammatically requiring a noun.
defs.ex: I’m as mad as hell and I’m not going to take it anymore.

defs.en: In certain games of chase, a place to which those who are caught are carried for detention.
Used to express discontent, unhappiness, or anger.
defs.ex: Oh, hell! I got another parking ticket.

defs.en: Used to emphasize.
defs.ex: Hell yeah!

defs.en: Used to introduce an intensified statement following an understated one; nay; not only that, but.
defs.ex: Do it, or, rest assured, there will be no more Middle Eastern crisis – hell, there will be no more Middle East!

defs.en: Very; used to emphasize strongly.
defs.ex: That was hell good!

defs.en: To make hellish; to place (someone) in hell; to make (a place) into a hell.
To hurry, rush.
To move quickly and loudly; to raise hell as part of motion.
defs.ex: He was helling down the road with his radio blaring.

defs.en: A pigmented filament of keratin which grows from a follicle on the skin of humans and other mammals.
The collection or mass of such growths growing from the skin of humans and animals, and forming a covering for any part or the whole body.
Specifically, the collection of hairs on the top and sides of the human head, growing from the scalp.
defs.ex: In the western world, women usually have long hair while men usually have short hair.

defs.en: A slender outgrowth from the chitinous cuticle of insects, spiders, crustaceans, and other invertebrates. Such hairs are totally unlike those of vertebrates in structure, composition, and mode of growth.
A cellular outgrowth of the epidermis, consisting of one or of several cells, whether pointed, hooked, knobbed, or stellated.
defs.ex: Internal hairs occur in the flower stalk of the yellow frog lily (Nuphar).

ja: (不可算) 髪。毛髪（のまとまり）。

defs.en: To remove the hair from.
To grow hair (where there was a bald spot).
To cause to have or bear hair; to provide with hair
To string the bow for a violin.
A large medical facility, usually in a building with multiple floors, where seriously ill or injured patients are given extensive medical or surgical treatment.
defs.ex: Luckily an ambulance arrived quickly and he was rushed to hospital.

defs.en: The eighth numeral symbol of the English alphabet, called aitch and written in the Latin script.
Very large.
Very strong, powerful, or dedicated.
defs.ex: Both of my parents are huge supporters of animal rights.

defs.en: Very interesting, significant, or popular.
defs.ex: The band's next album is going to be huge.

defs.en: A friendly, informal, casual greeting said upon someone's arrival.
defs.ex: Hi, how are you?

defs.en: An exclamation to call attention.
Expressing wonder or derision.
defs.ex: How did he do that, hi?

defs.en: The word "hi" used as a greeting.
defs.ex: I didn't even get a hi.

defs.en: A man in a marriage or marital relationship, especially in relation to his spouse.
defs.ex: You should start dating so you can find a suitable husband.

defs.en: A manager of property; one who has the care of another's belongings, owndom, or interests; a steward; an economist.
The master of a house; the head of a family; a householder.
A tiller of the ground; a husbandman.
The male of a pair of animals.

ja: 肘掛つきの大型クッション。husband pillow。

defs.en: To manage or administer carefully and frugally; use to the best advantage; economise.
To conserve.
To engage or act as a husband to; assume the care of or responsibility for; accept as one's own.
